title: Participation-Sensitive Convergence and the Fragment First, Converge Later Pattern in Asynchronous Online Learning: A Topological Analysis Across 22 OULAD Courses
abstract: arXiv:2610.01738v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Asynchronous online learning offers temporal flexibility at a structural cost: learning communities tend to fragment rather than cohere. $\beta_0$, the number of disconnected behavioral clusters from Zigzag Persistent Homology, serves as a cohort-level indicator of this structure. Two questions remained unverified at scale: (1) does apparent $\beta_0$ convergence reflect genuine behavioral alignment or learner dropout? and (2) do assessment deadlines produce reproducible fragmentation-convergence cycles? We address both across all 22 OULAD courses (N > 22,000; 857 week-pairs). Changes in $\beta_0$ strongly co-vary with active learner changes (pooled r = 0.387; median per-course r_delta = 0.459, 20/22 courses), identifying $\beta_0$ as a participation-sensitive indicator: $\beta_0$ and active learner counts co-respond to deadline events rather than one causing the other. translated_title: 参与敏感的收敛与异步在线学习中的“先分裂、后收敛”模式：基于22门OULAD课程的拓扑分析
translated_abstract: 异步在线学习在提供时间灵活性的同时付出了结构性代价：学习共同体往往趋向于分裂而非凝聚。β0（来自Zigzag持续同调的不连通行为聚类数量）可作为衡量这一结构的群体层面指标。此前有两个问题尚未在大规模上得到验证：（1）表面上的β0收敛反映的是真实的行为趋同，还是学习者流失？（2）评估截止日期是否会产生可复现的“分裂-收敛”循环？我们在全部22门OULAD课程（N > 22,000；857个周对）中对这两个问题进行了验证。结果显示，β0的变化与活跃学习者数量的变化强烈共变（合并r = 0.387；各课程r_delta中位数为0.459，22门课程中有20门呈此关系），这表明β0是一个参与敏感的指标：β0与活跃学习者人数共同响应截止日期事件，而非一方导致另一方。截止日期在82.6%的评估中引发了分裂现象，并呈现出“先分裂、后收敛”的模式。
tldr: 该研究基于22门OULAD课程（超22,000名学习者）的拓扑分析发现，Zigzag持续同调的β0是参与敏感指标，它与活跃学习者人数共同响应截止日期事件，且截止日期在82.6%的评估中引发“先分裂、后收敛”的群体行为模式。
en_tdlr: Using topological analysis across 22 OULAD courses (N > 22,000), this study shows that β0 from Zigzag Persistent Homology is a participation-sensitive indicator that co-responds with active learner counts to deadline events, with deadlines inducing fragmentation in 82.6% of assessments and a "fragment first, converge later" pattern.
